objective: Fix Ivan's Phan Level 5 resetting to Level 1 when changing to Van and returning, for every BUKLOD Character. Protect Circle Rank, points, unlocks, and existing production.
productionBaselineEvidence: On 16 Nov 2026 live Supabase read confirmed V2 setter overwrote one baseline on every switch; Ivan Cayoyong active Van with baseline/lifetime 522 and former earned Phan Level 5. Production backend migration buklod_character_per_character_progress_v3 at version 20261116044202 applied and conditional Phan 522-point checkpoint restored. Live read confirmed Phan saved Level 5 and Van active Level 1; switching tested transactionally with rollback. Main advanced concurrently; no frontend OTA is published. Source reconciled on exact main SHA fd11c370e1e0c159ce4c33787785cb74d1250a92 with existing Nov16 Matthew Henry/Bible changes preserved unchanged. Character visual source locks retained: current corrective PR intentionally leaves approved R31/R40 UI files untouched; inactive roster preview may still say Level 1 until activated.
chosenApproach: Keep authenticated V2 RPC names for existing app clients; save earned XP per character in a private RLS table, atomically checkpoint the current character on switch, resume saved XP, and expose a character_levels map for future UI adoption. Existing locked R31/R40 visuals stay byte-identical.
selectionRationale: Singleton selection baseline loses old XP by design. Separate per-character checkpoints solve the root cause without recalculating historical lifetime points or transferring XP across characters.
alternativeApproaches: Cache levels only on-device: rejected because reinstall, network, or another device would reset progress.
Make all characters inherit lifetime points: rejected because levels must progress independently.
Introduce paid backend services: rejected because the existing Supabase server can enforce persistence.
preserveBehaviors: Existing Phan/Quin/Van/Christian/Lhen and rank-gated special character unlocks, art and collectibles remain intact.
Circle Rank and lifetime points are never lowered or reset; earned XP belongs only to the character who earned it.
Duplicate or rapid selection requests are serialized/idempotent and old async reads cannot repaint a newer selection.
No changes to AdMob, dashboard navigation, audio, media, PTT, runtime or native configuration.
Existing R31/R40 approved Character UI blobs are byte-for-byte unchanged; only server-derived selected level changes.
Historical live-parity check still locks exact shipped R31/R40 UI blobs but now validates the V3 server-backed progression rule instead of obsolete V2 reset.
acceptanceChecks: Transactionally demonstrate Phan 5 -> Van 1 -> Phan 5 and same-character reselection does not reset.
Verify returning to Phan restores Level 5 on the active profile and selected character renderer while existing shipped R31/R40 visual source remains byte-identical.
Production getter reports saved Phan Level 5 and currently active Van Level 1 for Ivan without editing lifetime points.
Pass focused Node character and database regression checks, TypeScript, mandatory CI and staging RC before any frontend production OTA.
Avoid actual physical-device verification per owner preference; never claim it was performed.
Character recovery QA retains the OTA #173 four-file hash lock while asserting per-character V3 persistence, with no visual source changes.
